world.title: At least 27 killed as fire breaks out at pub in Bangkok
world.summary: A fire at a pub in Bangkok early on July 13, 2026, resulted in at least 27 fatalities, according to officials. Firefighters managed to control the blaze, but the cause remains under investigation. Eyewitness footage captured the intensity of the flames as first responders worked to extinguish the fire and rescue those trapped inside the establishment.

world.title: Thailand fire horror: At least 27 dead after midnight blaze tears through Bangkok pub; several injured
world.summary: A significant fire occurred at a pub in northern Bangkok early Monday, resulting in at least 27 fatalities and injuring 63 others, according to officials. The blaze started around midnight, causing extensive damage to the entertainment venue. Emergency services responded promptly, but the incident has raised concerns about safety regulations in public establishments across the city.

world.title: Iranian ballistic missiles target US base in Kuwait
world.summary: Iran reportedly launched three ballistic missiles targeting a US base in Kuwait, claiming to have destroyed American High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) batteries. The information was disseminated by the Iran-run Fars News Agency. This incident marks a significant escalation in tensions between Iran and the United States, highlighting ongoing military confrontations in the region.

business.title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade Gravita India, Equitas Small Finance Bank, Ion Exchange, Grasim, SBI Life Insurance, and others on July 13?
business.summary: On July 10, the Nifty 50 rose 1%, marking a second consecutive session of gains, supported by positive market breadth. Traders are advised to focus on short-term strategies for stocks like Gravita India, Equitas Small Finance Bank, Ion Exchange, Grasim, and SBI Life Insurance. The overall trend remains positive, despite potential consolidation phases, with attention on last week's highs.

business.title: Claude Fable 5 stays free for paid users until July 19 as Anthropic buys more time
business.summary: Anthropic has extended access to Claude Fable 5 for paid subscribers until July 19, allowing users an additional week to utilize the advanced model. This extension applies to subscribers of Pro, Max, Team, and premium Enterprise plans. Previously, the company had indicated that Fable 5 would be included in these subscription tiers, enhancing user experience and access.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: LTM, Avenue Supermarts, Swiggy, Pace Digitek, Power Grid, Powerica, RITES, Keystone Realtors, Sterlite Tech, L&T Finance in focus on 13 July
business.summary: On July 13, 2026, several stocks will be in focus, including LTM, Avenue Supermarts, Adani Green Energy, Keystone Realtors, Mankind Pharma, Lux Industries, RITES, JSW Energy, Powerica, Innovision, NTPC, NMDC, Sterlite Technologies, Pace Digitek, Power Grid Corporation of India, and Swiggy. Investors are advised to monitor these companies for potential market movements and developments.

technology.title: on Video Leak Ahead of Launch, 7,100mAh Battery & 90W Charging Officially Confirmed ~ My Mobile India
technology.summary: Motorola's upcoming Edge 70 Max features a premium design, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor, and a QHD+ 144Hz display. Official confirmations reveal a 7,100mAh battery, the largest in Motorola's lineup, supporting 90W wired and 25W magnetic wireless charging. Live images showcase a glass back, aluminum frame, flat display, slim bezels, and a square silver camera module.

technology.title: PlayStation Fans Weigh PC Move, Survey Finds
technology.summary: A recent Push Square poll reveals that nearly 45% of PlayStation fans are contemplating a switch to PC gaming, influenced by concerns over physical games, pricing, and the upcoming PS6. In contrast, only 23% of respondents expressed a commitment to remaining with the PlayStation platform. This shift in sentiment highlights changing preferences among the gaming community.

technology.title: Pokémon GO celebrates a decade of mobile success
technology.summary: Pokémon GO marks its 10th anniversary with a live raid event in Times Square and announces a free GO Fest 2026 Global tier. The event will feature Mega Mewtwo Y and Zeraora. Since its launch in 2015, Pokémon GO has attracted large crowds and maintained a dedicated player base, celebrating a decade of mobile gaming success.

sports.title: Gianni Infantino says FIFA will examine possibility of 64-team World Cup
sports.summary: Gianni Infantino announced that FIFA will consider expanding the men's World Cup to 64 teams following the 2026 tournament. He emphasized that every nation should have the opportunity to aspire to participate in football's premier event. This potential expansion reflects FIFA's ongoing commitment to inclusivity and growth in international football, aiming to enhance the global reach of the tournament.

sports.title: Wimbledon final: Sinner outclasses Zverev to retain All England crown
sports.summary: Jannik Sinner defeated Alexander Zverev 6-7(7), 7-6(2), 6-3, 6-4 to win his second consecutive Wimbledon title and fifth Grand Slam overall. The match showcased Sinner's skill as he methodically dismantled Zverev's game. This victory on Centre Court solidifies Sinner's position among the top players in tennis, marking a significant achievement in his career.

sports.title: FIFA's top four teams make World Cup semifinals for first time
sports.summary: Argentina, Spain, France, and England, the top four teams in FIFA's rankings, have reached the World Cup semifinals for the first time since the rankings were introduced in 1992. This historic lineup features four previous champions and includes five of the six top scorers, highlighting a significant moment in soccer history as they compete for the championship.

health.title: Long COVID may be damaging your brain's Dopamine system, groundbreaking study finds
health.summary: A new study from the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health indicates that Long COVID may impair the brain's dopamine system. This condition affects approximately five percent of the global population, including two million Canadians, and is associated with various persistent symptoms, particularly cognitive issues like fatigue and brain fog. Further research is needed to understand these effects.

health.title: Irregular periods in young women: Doctor reveals the warning signs many ignore that could signal a hidden health problem
health.summary: Irregular periods in young women can cause significant concern, leading to questions about potential health issues. Factors such as stress may contribute, but underlying medical conditions could also be at play. Experts emphasize the importance of recognizing warning signs and consulting a doctor when irregularities occur, as early intervention can address potential health problems effectively.

health.title: WHO says Ebola outbreak still spreading in Congo
health.summary: The World Health Organization reported that four out of five new Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo lack known links to existing patients. A senior official cautioned that the actual scale of the outbreak might be two to four times larger than current data indicates. This highlights significant challenges for health authorities in managing the ongoing crisis.

science.title: 3.1 billion-year-old Australian rocks reveal evidence of Earth's ancient water cycle
science.summary: Scientists have identified evidence of Earth's ancient deep water cycle by examining 3.1 billion-year-old rocks located in the Pilbara Craton of Western Australia. This discovery sheds light on the planet's early hydrological processes, suggesting that water was present and cycling through the Earth's crust much earlier than previously understood, contributing to knowledge about the planet's geological history.

science.title: Scientists just created a Black Hole-like energy system in a lab without moving anything, recreating a 50-year-old theory that could transform future communication and quantum technology
science.summary: Physicists have developed a stationary laboratory device that replicates certain extreme physics of black holes, validating a 50-year-old theory. This system utilizes electromagnetic waves interacting with a rotating mechanism to amplify selected rotation patterns. The breakthrough could significantly impact future communication and quantum technology, offering new insights into the behavior of energy systems akin to black holes.

science.title: Earth may escape the Sun, but life still has an expiry date, scientists say
science.summary: A new study indicates that Earth may avoid being engulfed by the Sun when it expands into a red giant in approximately five billion years. However, scientists warn that the planet will become uninhabitable long before that, as rising temperatures will render it too hot to support life. This challenges previous predictions about Earth's fate in the solar system.

entertainment.title: Marvel 'Avengers: Doomsday' Cast Reveal: Full First Look
entertainment.summary: Marvel Studios revealed the cast and concept art for "Avengers: Doomsday" during the Bilibili World Expo in Shanghai on July 12, 2026. The artwork features Doctor Doom, the X-Men, the Fantastic Four, and showcases three universes. The film boasts a massive ensemble cast of 34 stars, marking a significant expansion of the Marvel cinematic universe.

entertainment.title: Muzammil Ibrahim reacts to viral no regrets clip on break-up with Deepika Padukone
entertainment.summary: Actor Muzammil Ibrahim addressed a viral clip from an older interview discussing his breakup with Deepika Padukone. He clarified that the footage lacks full context, emphasizing his intention to speak honestly and respectfully. The resurfacing of the clip has reignited discussions online, but Ibrahim wants to ensure that his comments are understood in their entirety.

entertainment.title: Muzammil Ibrahim breaks silence on saying he has ‘no regrets’ about breakup with Deepika Padukone
entertainment.summary: An old interview of actor-model Muzammil Ibrahim discussing his breakup with Deepika Padukone has resurfaced online, prompting criticism. In the clip, Ibrahim states he has "no regrets" about the relationship and reveals he was the one who ended it. The renewed attention on his comments has sparked discussions among fans and media regarding their past relationship.
